name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Checkbox. Square ink box; hover thickens the line (no screentone under 24px); checked is an ink flat with a brush check that draws itself in three frames; indeterminate is a thick bar; disabled is dashed; aria-invalid uses the accent colour.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox". It wraps your own components/ui/checkbox, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A square box; the brush check draws itself.
meta.usage:
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox"

<label className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Checkbox defaultChecked /> Notify me
</label>
